title: Biphasic extraction of metabolites in algal matrix or periphyton
author: Mélissa ME EON
materials: PREPARATION OF EXTRACTION MIXTURES – UPLC GRADE (HERE FOR 60 REPLICATES!) • Prepare an MTBE:MeOH mixture (3:1, v:v) => 150 mL stored at 4 °C for maximum one week • Prepare a mixture H2O:MeOH (3:1, v:v) => 100 mL stored at 4 °C for maximum one week MTBE: Sigma Chromasolv 99.8% for HPLC 100mL (smallest available) (34875-100mL) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #34875-100ML Methanol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #M3641 MilliQ water Contributed by users

steps.title: Define experimental replicates and blanks
steps.instruction: Allocate 4–6 replicates per experimental sample. For environmental samples add pesticide internal standards (IS) and metabolite/lipid IS. For laboratory samples add IS of the investigated compound plus metabolite/lipid IS. Prepare 3 procedural blank replicates (solvent only) and 2 blind blank replicates (solvent with all IS). Prepare 2 spike replicates: Spike 1 – reference sample spiked with SST + pesticide + PE (15:0) before extraction and IS after extraction; Spike 2 – reference sample with IS only after extraction.

steps.title: Prepare doping mixture solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following mixtures: SST mix at 50 ppm, pesticide mix at 3.3 ppm, IS pesticides at 2.5 ppm, IS metabolites at 50 ppm, and PE (15:0) at 100 ppm. Sonicate each mixture for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare crushed ice and cold blocks
steps.instruction: Run the ice machine continuously throughout the extraction to generate crushed ice. Place cold blocks at –80 °C together with micro‑tube racks.

steps.title: Prepare bead tubes and amber vials
steps.instruction: Label all 2 mL tubes. Add 150 mg ± 10 mg of 0.5 mm glass beads to each tube. Label duplicate 1.8 mL amber stock vials for the lipophilic and hydrophilic fractions (pre‑labeling can be done the day before).

steps.title: Add matrix and internal standards
steps.instruction: On ice in the sound‑check room, add 10 mg ± 1 mg freeze‑dried matrix to each bead tube and record the exact mass. Add internal standards as follows: environmental sample – 10 µL IS pesticides + 10 µL IS metabolites + 50 µL PE (15:0); laboratory sample – 10 µL IS of the test compound + 10 µL IS metabolites + 10 µL PE (15:0); spike 1 – 10 µL SST mix + 10 µL pesticide mix + PE (15:0) pre‑extraction; spike 2 – IS only post‑extraction.

steps.title: Pre‑cool reagents and start centrifuge
steps.instruction: Place the tubes and the MTBE:MeOH solution at –80 °C and the H₂O:MeOH solutions at –20 °C for 15 min. Start the centrifuge fast‑temp setting at 4 °C.

steps.title: First biphasic extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL MTBE:MeOH (3:1) to each tube. Run FastPrep‑24 5G (MP Biomedicals, catalog 116005500) for 15 s at 6.5 m s⁻¹, then keep on ice or –80 °C for 3 min. Repeat a second FastPrep cycle and 3‑min cooling. Add 650 µL H₂O:MeOH, run a third FastPrep cycle (15 s, 6.5 m s⁻¹) and 3‑min cooling. Centrifuge at 12 000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 min. Under the hood on ice, transfer 500 µL of the upper lipophilic layer and 600 µL of the lower hydrophilic layer into separate labeled amber 1.8 mL vials using a micropipette. Retain the remaining aqueous phase for the second extraction.

steps.title: Second biphasic extraction
steps.instruction: To the retained aqueous phase add 700 µL MTBE:MeOH (3:1). Run a FastPrep cycle (15 s, 6.5 m s⁻¹) and keep on ice or –80 °C for 3 min; repeat a second cycle and cooling. Add 455 µL H₂O:MeOH, run a third FastPrep cycle (15 s, 6.5 m s⁻¹) and 3‑min cooling. Centrifuge at 12 000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 min. Under the hood on ice, transfer 600 µL lipophilic layer and 700 µL hydrophilic layer into the same amber vials used in step 7. Weigh each amber stock (theoretical volumes: 1.1 mL lipophilic, 1.3 mL hydrophilic).

steps.title: Add post‑extraction IS and store
steps.instruction: To each amber vial add 10 µL IS metabolites and 10 µL IS pesticides. Store all vials at –80 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Hydrophilic fraction for UPLC‑TOF
steps.instruction: Sonicate 500 µL of the hydrophilic extract for 5 min. Transfer to clear vials. Evaporate solvent in a Genevac EZ‑2 at 30 °C for 30 min (hydro mode). Reconstitute with 100 µL H₂O:ACN (50:50) (Acetonitrile ULC‑MS, Biosolve Catalog #0001204101BS) and place into the insert. Prepare a QC pool by mixing 10 µL of each sample in an amber vial (no insert), then create QC/2 and QC/4 dilutions and spike the pool with leucine 1 ppm at 1/100. Prepare a calibration range using SST mix, pesticide mix and PE (15:0) with fixed concentrations of metabolite and pesticide IS (see catalog links in original text).

steps.title: Lipophilic fraction for UPLC‑TOF
steps.instruction: Sonicate 500 µL of the lipophilic extract for 5 min. Transfer to clear vials. Evaporate in a Genevac EZ‑2 at 30 °C for 20 min (lipo mode). Reconstitute with 100 µL ISO:ACN (50:50) (Isopropanol HyperSolv CHROMANORM, VWR International/Avantor) and place into the insert. Perform the same QC pool, QC/2, QC/4 and leucine spike as described in step 10. Prepare a calibration range with SST mix, pesticide mix and PE (15:0) with fixed IS concentrations.

steps.title: Lipophilic fraction for HPLC‑MS/MS
steps.instruction: Sonicate 125 µL of the lipophilic extract for 5 min. Transfer into the insert of a clear vial. Dry under nitrogen flow at room temperature. Add injection solvent for a 1:2 final dilution: 250 µL isopropanol + 50 µL IS polar lipids. The sample is now ready for glycolipid and phospholipid analysis by HPLC‑MS/MS.
